title: Chapter 1212
text:
A few days later …

You have mastered [Mechanical Force-Soldier Nest]!

You have mastered [Compressed Orb Innovation-Martial Body]!

You have …

A compressed orb was placed on the workbench in front of him. Han Xiao controlled the mechanical arm and completed the processing in no time. He then picked up the specially made compressed orb and placed it flat on his palm. A weak Mechanical Force arc shot out from his finger and covered the compressed orb.

Hum …

The next moment, the compressed orb suddenly shrank to the size of a cell and returned to his body with the Mechanical Force.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and felt an extremely weak burden. With a thought, a stream of Mechanical Force wrapped around this particle-like special compressed orb and shot it out. The compressed orb instantly expanded in the electric arc and landed on the ground, turning into a mechanical soldier covered in electric sparks. It looked as though Han Xiao had shot out a mechanical soldier directly from his body.

"This is the ability to transform oneself into an army camp …"

Han Xiao nodded to himself. After a few days of learning, he had already mastered this set of abilities.

The principle of Class Knowledge was the same, and most of the Class Skills were the same. Only the content related to the secondary dimensions was slightly different, causing the basic strength of the Super system here to be inferior to the explored universe. Han Xiao did not expect these skills to be very strong. The biggest use of these Class Skills was to bring about some new directions and bonuses.

Because Class Knowledge was generally the same, these different Class Skills were different in terms of application, so it was not difficult for him to learn them. Furthermore, with the help of the interface, he had basically learned all the Class Skills that Jayz had taught him. In his opinion, the most useful one was this ability to transform oneself into an army camp.

"The burden is not low. When the Mech Legion is stored in my body, my Health and Energy limit will decrease. After releasing the legion, although the limit will be restored, my current Health and Energy will not be restored …"

Han Xiao analyzed.

The mechanism of this ability was similar to Apostilization. For a normal Mechanic, even if they released the legion in battle, their current Health and Energy would not be restored at the same time. Thus, it would cause the Mechanic to become even more fragile.

However, this ability was very compatible with him. He had a strong recovery ability that allowed him to quickly recover during battle. In this way, the side effects of this "Body Barracks" on him were almost negligible. It was equivalent to freeloading.

Furthermore, with his own tankiness, the size of the troops that his main body could carry far exceeded that of a normal Mechanic.

As expected, increasing the tankiness of a Mechanic was the correct development path!

At the side, Jayce watched as Han Xiao tested his abilities with a subtle expression. He could not help but speak.

"You learned it just like that?"

"Isn't that simple?" Han Xiao didn't think much of it.

"Is, is that so …"

Jess's face twitched.

He thought that he wouldn't be surprised anymore, but Han Xiao's incredible learning speed had caused ripples in his calm heart.

Did I meet a genius among geniuses, or did the Mechanics of the later Universe Iterations all evolve to such an extent?

Furthermore, in the past few days, the two of them had sparred a little. Jayce had never seen a Mechanic with such a style before.

In his Universe Iteration, due to the lack of secondary dimensions, the strength of a Mechanic was not that abnormal. Most of the time, they were positioned as a fragile damage output. Furthermore, they had to do well in logistics and lay out the ground in advance.

However, this was the first time he had seen a Mechanic like Han Xiao, and he could not help but feel puzzled.

Why was this guy even more tanky than a Pugilist?

Could it be that pursuing a strong physique was the mainstream development path of the Mechanics of the later Iterations?

It was really as if one could see anything after living for a long time …

Han Xiao naturally did not know what Jayce was thinking. After testing his new ability for a while, he turned around and asked,

"Isn't it time to give me the technology you've accumulated?"

Hearing this, Jayce calmed down, tapped on a virtual screen, and operated it a little. Very soon, a dense list of technical projects appeared on the screen.

"These are the technical information I've sorted out. You can copy them. I'll send the rest to you when you're about to complete the mission."

Han Xiao glanced at it and was overjoyed.

Compared to the Class Skills, these technical materials were the real deal. They represented countless new blueprints!

Furthermore, it was not just Jayce's own research projects. In the thousands of cycles, Jayce was a wanted criminal at least nine hundred times. Relying on the restart of the cycles, he boldly invaded the database of many advanced civilizations and learned the advanced technologies that these civilizations had invested countless time, energy, and wealth into developing. His foundation was amazing, and now, they were all being sold by Jayce without hesitation.

Han Xiao quickly copied them with his own device. Although it was only a portion, it was already a huge technical treasure, enough for him to study for a long time.

There were many Gold Grade blueprints among them, which was equivalent to saving a lot of Contribution Points to the three Universal Civilizations. He did not have to continue working for the three Universal Civilizations to exchange blueprints.

As long as he obtained the remaining technology and completed his research, he would be able to overtake Old Manison at the bend, leaving him so far behind that Old Manison wouldn't even be able to smell his exhaust.

"By the way, can you get the Class Knowledges of the other four Super systems here?" Han Xiao asked.

"I've collected such things before, but I couldn't learn them due to the conflict between the systems, so I didn't record them. I could only store them in the machine. After the cycle restarts, this information will naturally be gone." Jayce shook his head. "However, if you want, I can get them for you."

After restarting the cycle many times, Jayce was like a walking guide. This was not difficult for him.

"Then, I'll leave it to you." Han Xiao nodded.

If he obtained the Class Knowledges of all the systems here, he would be able to obtain the complete Class Knowledges of the five major systems without the three Universal Civilizations knowing. Although it lacked the content of the secondary dimensions, the value was huge enough.

It was just that unlike him, who had someone to teach him, he did not know if others could comprehend the other Class Skills through the different knowledge content.

This time, Jayce slowly said, "I've given you all the information I can. Now, it's your turn to help me. Do you have a plan?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao nodded.

"I have some ideas. I plan to use the resources of the Eye of Insight to build a Mech Legion. Let's replenish our combat power first …"

Invading the Superpower Security Department's warehouse was not an easy task. Furthermore, the dimensional consciousness entity had many doppelgangers. Currently, this army was not enough, so Han Xiao planned to spend some time to expand the army.

Because this secondary dimension was an Information Form Phantom, the mechanical army built with the materials of the Eye of Insight could not be brought away. It was a one-off army built only for this mission, so there was no need to worry about losses.

…

On the other side, in the explored universe, the Flickering World …

The opening ceremony of the fourth Pro League would be held in less than ten days. Countless foreign players who had just joined the army in this version were crazily looking for Han Xiao.

After the previous few Pro Leagues, the Black Star Character Summon Card had already proven its dominance. It was tanky and had high damage output. Who knew how many foreign players were envious of it? Unfortunately, due to geographical reasons, they could not come into contact with Black Star in the previous versions. Naturally, they could not inscribe a Character Summon Card, so this had become the exclusive trump card of the Chinese players.

However, Version 4.0 was different. Players from various countries gathered in a Star Field, and countless foreigners entered the Black Star Corps. Now, their dreams had finally come true, and they also had a chance to obtain a Black Star Character Summon Card.

However, at this critical juncture, Black Star was on a business trip and could not be found!

Who knew how many times they had inquired, but in the end, they returned with no results. Countless army newcomers were frustrated. Seeing that the date of the Pro League was approaching, they could only helplessly change the target of their Character Summon Card.

Although the effect was not bad, many people felt that it was a pity that they could not inscribe a Black Star Character Summon Card. They felt that the blank Character Summon Cards that they had painstakingly hoarded could not be used to their fullest potential.

Compared to the previous few Pro Leagues, the competition system of this Pro League was not changed much. It only added a few more entertainment competitions. Amidst the anticipation of the players, the fourth Pro League officially began.

Compared to the previous few Pro Leagues, the atmosphere of this Pro League was much more tense. No club wanted to see any country achieve the achievement of three consecutive championships. China, which had already won two consecutive championships, was attacked even more.

It was not just the clubs of various countries. The past achievements of the various clubs in China had won them a lot of popularity. In the competition, these passionate fans loved to chase down their favorite players, in the name of seeking interaction …

…

In the blink of an eye, a few months passed.

In the meeting room of the Eye of Revelation, Han Xiao, Kasuyi, and Jayce gathered.

"Black Star, are we going to take action?" Kasuyi turned his head and asked.

"Yes. During this time, I've already expanded the size of the army. It's basically enough. There's no need to delay any longer."

Han Xiao nodded.

Over the past few months, he had been using the resources of the Eye of Revelation to maximize the efficiency of [Billion Mecha Empire — Manison] by fifty times. A few days ago, the size of the army had finally reached the storage limit of the main body's barracks. Only then did he stop the production.

"Very good. Let's quickly resolve this matter so as to avoid any more problems. Furthermore, the opportunity for my God's Trait Transformation is probably devouring the energy fragments of this destroyed secondary dimension," Kasuyi said.

He had not been idle over the past few months and had been sensing the opportunity for his God's Trait Transformation. He had also gained some benefits.

It was no wonder that the object of his senses was the entire secondary dimension. Kasuyi had discovered that the opportunity was most likely the energy fragments of the dimensional core. Thus, he became even more concerned about breaking this cycle of spacetime.

Han Xiao opened a map. The map showed the location and topography of the Superpower Security Department's warehouse. This was the result of Jayce's scouting in the previous cycles.

"The warehouse of the Superpower Security Department is in the headquarters, and there are many Beyond Grade A officers on standby in the headquarters as well as a large number of troops. The success rate of a frontal attack is extremely low. Our first task is to infiltrate … The Heaven Concealing Apparatus can only block the positioning star map, and normal detection methods are still effective. Thus, we need another infiltration plan, and this requires Jayce's help."

Hearing this, Jayce said, "I've joined the Superpower Security Department many times.

"I've joined the Superpower Security Department many times in the past and have mastered most of their authority, secret orders, and access codes. I'm also clear about their activities. I can forge your information and let you sneak in. I've always helped outsiders like this before, but there's a risk of being exposed …"

The Superpower Security Department's security was tight, but it could not withstand Jayce's repeated attempts to reboot it. He was like a backdoor player. The headquarters that was impregnable in the eyes of ordinary people was full of flaws in his eyes.

Han Xiao continued. "This time, we won't use this method. The warehouse has been enveloped by the space stabilization device, and normal teleportation methods are ineffective. However, as long as we find a way to get the people of the Superpower Security Department to send the King mechanical suit's teleportation beacon, 'Throne', into the warehouse, we can directly descend."

"Okay, we'll do it in one go!" Kasuyi's eyes lit up. He liked this straightforward method.

Jayce explained, "All the items in the warehouse will be isolated and screened to remove dangerous and useless items. The screening process is divided into artificial and artificial, and the process will be repeated three times.

However, there are exceptions, and that is, if the item is authorized by the department leader or the director, it does not need to be screened and can be temporarily stored in the outermost warehouse. If it is a secret order from the upper echelons of the Celestial Star Alliance, it can be stored directly in the depths of the warehouse. "

"So, you plan to forge the authority of the Superpower Security Department's leader?"

Kasuyi asked.

Jayce shook his head.

"No need. When I was in the previous cycle, I kidnapped the upper echelons of the Celestial Star Alliance many times. Although I was killed in the end, I still got their authority and memorized it in my mind. It's not difficult to forge it. I can send the Throne to the depths of the warehouse, and the carrier of the dimensional consciousness entity is also inside."

Kasuyi was speechless.

Being able to reboot really meant that he could do whatever he wanted. Awesome.

Jayce slowly said,

"Every item in the warehouse is stored separately. I will send you the warehouse number where the carrier is located later.

Once you teleport in, you will trigger an alarm, and the experts left in the headquarters will go over to encircle you. I have a technology here that can temporarily interfere with the illusion of the information form of the space-time cycle, causing space-time to slow down or even stagnate. However, the duration is limited, and it can only delay these officers for a short while.

You need to hurry up and kill the core of the dimensional consciousness entity. Don't get entangled by its doppelgangers. Once its program disintegrates, the information form transformation technology of the World Reboot Plan will be terminated, and the illusion of the space-time cycle will collapse. "

Han Xiao nodded and added.

"In order to reduce resistance as much as possible, we need to appear somewhere else before teleporting. Remove the Heaven Concealing Apparatus and let the Superpower Security Department track us with the positioning star map. This will lead a group of officers away from the Superpower Security Department."

"Okay." Kasuyi agreed.

The three of them had another discussion and finalized the details. Then, they began to act separately.
